Data:Pie.sea.json.Label: Sea-Pie
Data:Pie.sea.json.Desc: Once a treat for sailors, hence the name. [With the Spices and Savours skill, and pears, you might recreate a legendary dish.]

xexts.scrutiny: Appetite satisfied. [If you make this another time, try adding Pears and spice once it's complete.]

Data:Pie.vegetable.spring.json.Label: Steamed Spring Vegetable Pie
Data:Pie.vegetable.spring.json.Desc: Originally a product of Lord Berners' kitchens at Faringdon House; favoured by Heber-Percy, 'the Mad Boy', Berners' companion, who inlaid the floor of his changing room with pennies and built steps up to his swimming pool…

Data:Pigment.json.label: Pigment
Data:Pigment.json.desc: Call it a colour, call it a stain, call it a jewel-in-waiting.

Data:Pigment.refulgin.json.Label: Refulgin
Data:Pigment.refulgin.json.Desc: A white so pure that it remains visible even in utter darkness, like the moon, or an insistent cat.

xexts.scrutiny: Shiny! Ish. [There are Prentice-level Lantern recipes which can craft this.]

Data:Pilchards.json.Label: Pilchards
Data:Pilchards.json.Desc: [Pickle them alone; or they're pretty good on toast.]

xexts.scrutiny: They're just really big sardines. Or sardines are really small pilchards. This is the mystery.
How does one know when one has acquired a taste?

Data:Pitcher.water.numa.h.json.Label: Mist-Kissed Water (Half-Pitcher)
Data:Pitcher.water.numa.h.json.Desc: The faintest of vapours still ghosts the water's surface.

xexts.scrutiny: This is the nature of the taste of mist-kissed water: that one forgets it even as the taste passes from the tongue.

Data:Pitcher.water.numa.json.Desc: The faintest of vapours still ghosts the water's surface.

xexts.scrutiny: This is the nature of the taste of mist-kissed water: that one forgets it even as the taste passes from the tongue.

Data:Plums.json.Label: Plums
Data:Plums.json.Desc: [Add Bread and use a Knife for Plum Croutons, or an Egg and use Mixing Bowls for Prune Whip.]

Data:Porphyrine.json.Label: Porphyrine
Data:Porphyrine.json.Desc: The encaustum terminale of the Second History. It's the glowing crimson-mauve of the Secret Histories. Porphyrine was venerated in secret by a confraternity of corresponding Cluniacs and Benedictines. [Use an Encaustum ink with your Journal to make Determinations and record Histories. If the Hours listen, the world changes... Porphyrine might also be used to compose a petition for the labyrinth season, if you can provide at least 20 of , , or ; no , , or at all; and suitable writing material.]

xexts.scrutiny: Another history spilt… [Certain Keeper-level Lantern and Rose recipes can brew this from Ichor Auroral, and perhaps from other things.]

Data:Post.ready.json.label: Ready to Post
Data:Post.ready.json.desc: This message will find its destination... once properly sanctioned by the powers of the post-box. [Take it to the Post Office, with cash for a stamp or a postal order.]

Data:Posting.json.label: In the Post
Data:Posting.json.desc: This is used to evoke comments when sending something, since 'delivering' happens offstage.

Data:Postoffice.break.crown.json.label: Break a Crown
Data:Postoffice.break.crown.json.startdescription: The Postmistress will accept the offering and bestow upon me the appropriate change.
Data:Postoffice.break.crown.json.desc: A crown broken into a muted rainbow of silver.

Data:Postoffice.break.fivepoundnote.json.label: Break a Five Pound Note
Data:Postoffice.break.fivepoundnote.json.startdescription: The Postmistress will accept the offering and bestow upon me the appropriate change.
Data:Postoffice.break.fivepoundnote.json.desc: Four lesser notes and a handful of greater-sibling lesser-sibling coins. 'Thus is Equilibrium maintained.'

Data:Postoffice.break.florin.json.label: Break a Florin
Data:Postoffice.break.florin.json.startdescription: The Postmistress will accept the offering and bestow upon me the appropriate change.
Data:Postoffice.break.florin.json.desc: I surrender the florin and receive an unruly handful of lesser coins

Data:Postoffice.break.halfcrown.json.label: Break a Half Crown
Data:Postoffice.break.halfcrown.json.startdescription: The Postmistress will accept the offering and bestow upon me the appropriate change.
Data:Postoffice.break.halfcrown.json.desc: A pedant, or a poet, might suggest that a half crown cannot ever have been whole, and so might not be broken. They wouldn't suggest it to the Postmistress, though..

Data:Postoffice.break.hint.json.label: Too Petty Cash
Data:Postoffice.break.hint.json.startdescription: The Postmistress will break larger currency into change, but don't tempt her anger with so mean and small a coin as this.

Data:Postoffice.break.onepoundnote.json.label: Break a One Pound Note
Data:Postoffice.break.onepoundnote.json.startdescription: The Postmistress will accept the offering and bestow upon me the appropriate change.
Data:Postoffice.break.onepoundnote.json.desc: One pound note exchanged for a handful of lesser coins. 'Thus is Equilibrium maintained.'

Data:Postoffice.break.sevenpoundnote.jso.label: Break a Seven Pound Note
Data:Postoffice.break.sevenpoundnote.jso.startdescription: The Postmistress will accept the offering and bestow upon me the appropriate change.
Data:Postoffice.break.sevenpoundnote.jso.desc: Three lesser notes. 'Thus is Equilibrium maintained.'

Data:Postoffice.break.shilling.json.label: Break a Shilling
Data:Postoffice.break.shilling.json.startdescription: The Postmistress will accept the offering and bestow upon me the appropriate change. (This is the smallest coin she will deign to change.)

Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.bronze.js.label: Sell a Bronze Spintria
Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.bronze.js.startdescription: Spintriae are not legal tender. But no law prevents the Postmistress from purchasing them from me. Perhaps she collects them. [This is worth ten shillings.]
Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.bronze.js.desc: The Postmistress scrutinises the design on the spintria.'Fire warms,' she says softly, 'night ends.' She hands me a ten shilling note.

Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.gold.json.label: Sell a Gold Spintria
Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.gold.json.startdescription: Spintriae are not legal tender. But no law prevents the Postmistress from purchasing them from me. Perhaps she collects them. [This is worth two pounds.]
Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.gold.json.desc: The Postmistress scrutinises the spintria's surface. 'A noble endeavour,' she remarks. She hands me two crisp pound notes.

Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.iron.json.label: Sell an Iron Spintria
Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.iron.json.startdescription: Spintriae are not legal tender. But no law prevents the Postmistress from purchasing them from me. Perhaps she collects them. [This is worth five shillings.]
Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.iron.json.desc: The Postmistress scrutinises the design on the spintria. 'And they say that speech is a sword,' she remarks. She hands me a coin.

Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.silver.js.label: Sell a Silver Spintria
Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.silver.js.startdescription: Spintriae are not legal tender. But no law prevents the Postmistress from purchasing them from me. Perhaps she collects them. [This is worth one pound and ten shillings.]
Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.silver.js.desc: The Postmistress scrutinises the design on the spintria's surface. Is she smiling? She says nothing, only hands me the payment.

Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.tin.json.label: Sell a Tin Spintria
Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.tin.json.startdescription: Spintriae are not legal tender. But no law prevents the Postmistress from purchasing them from me. Perhaps she collects them. [This is worth one pound.]
Data:Postoffice.break.spintria.tin.json.desc: The Postmistress scrutinises the design on the spintria. She sighs. 'This is why the King came here,' she says quietly, 'so long ago. But it was not enough.' She hands me a single pound note.

Data:Postoffice.break.tenshillingnote.js.label: Break a Ten-Shilling Note
Data:Postoffice.break.tenshillingnote.js.startdescription: The Postmistress will accept the offering and bestow upon me the appropriate change.
Data:Postoffice.break.tenshillingnote.js.desc: Ten shillings, discarnated into lesser coins.

Data:Postoffice.invitation.json.label: Visitor arriving after an invitation's been sent from the Post Office. We now use specific-art spontaneous ones for each visitor, so this is unused, but keeping it cos the multiple is important if we need a generic one again.

Data:Postoffice.invitation.send.arthur.j.label: Arthur Moore Incoming?
Data:Postoffice.invitation.send.arthur.j.startdescription: Did Arthur Moore receive my invitation?

Data:Postoffice.invitation.send.douglas..label: Douglas Moore Incoming?
Data:Postoffice.invitation.send.douglas..startdescription: Did Douglas Moore receive my invitation?
